paragraphs: NAVBLUE sells digital software for aviation operations, and its site now presents the business as part of Skywise, formed from the merger of NAVBLUE solutions and Skywise Digital solutions. The software is aimed at aircraft operators broadly, including those flying fleets that are not built by Airbus.

The portfolio is organized around planning and operations control, flight, technical and ground operations. Planning tools cover network, fleet and crew from long-term planning through daily execution and the handling of disruptions. The technical side addresses fleet availability, maintenance efficiency, continuing airworthiness and compliance. Underneath sits Skywise Core, described as a way to consolidate, enrich and analyse data in one secure platform.

News posts name Corsair as the first airline in France to adopt Mission+ FLIGHT for pilot workflows and flight operations. Another says Hong Kong Air Cargo chose a suite of NAVBLUE solutions. The site also describes a Digital Alliance with Airbus, Delta, GE Aerospace, Liebherr and Collins covering analytics for maintenance, asset management and flight operations.

quote.text: Interoperable digital solutions for end-to-end operations
